description.de: Rund um Workflows: liest die Felder event und ref aus dem JSON-Body eines Webhook-Aufrufs, 0 Tokens. So geht's: einen Webhook für diesen Workflow anlegen (Modul webhooks) und mit dem Härtungsschalter webhook-signatures ein Signatur-Secret erzeugen; jeder Aufruf schickt dann X-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 des Bodys>, sonst 401. Felder des Bodys gelten als fremde Eingabe. Ersetze die Verarbeitung.
description.en: Around workflows: reads the fields event and ref from a webhook call's JSON body, 0 tokens. How to: add a webhook for this workflow (module webhooks) and create a signing secret with the hardening switch webhook-signatures; every call then sends X-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the body>, otherwise 401. Body fields count as outside input. Replace the processing.

config.command:
set -eu
# event and ref come from the webhook body; started by hand without them the placeholder text stays
event=$(printf '%s' {{ event }})
ref=$(printf '%s' {{ ref }})
case "$event" in *'{{'*) event='(not set - started by hand)' ;; esac
case "$ref" in *'{{'*) ref='(not set)' ;; esac
# placeholder - replace with what should happen for this event
printf 'event=%s\nref=%s\n' "$event" "$ref"

description.de: Body-Felder werden zu Variablen des Laufs ({{ event }}, {{ ref }}). shell_escape_variables quotet sie, damit ein fremder Wert nie Teil des Befehls wird. Ersetze die Verarbeitung.
description.en: Body fields become variables of the run ({{ event }}, {{ ref }}). shell_escape_variables quotes them, so an outside value never becomes part of the command. Replace the processing.
